_help: Windows version (10-page turntable) — see 3d-model-iges.linux-macos.json for a simpler single-angle Linux/macOS version. IGES files, split out from 3d-model.json for the same reason as 3d-model-step.json: f3d 3.5.0 can't auto-detect the occt IGES reader from the .iges/.igs extension alone. Waydir ignores every key starting with "_".
_help_paging: 10 pages turning the model around its Z axis: --up=+Z makes Z the up axis, and %ANGLE% is 0, 36, 72 ... 324 degrees for pages 1-10 (PageUp/PageDown in Quick Look). Models authored Y-up (glTF by spec) will lie on their side with --up=+Z.
